        QTR HR Services - Our client, a Law Firm, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Executive Secretary
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Our client a Law Firm is looking to hire a highly skilled and experienced Executive Secretary who will provide high-level executive, administrative and secretarial support to Partners and other fee-earners within the firm to enable them to operate at optimum efficiency.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage and maintain Partners’ calendars, schedule meetings, appointments and court dates. Assist Partners in prioritizing their day, including meetings, appointments, correspondence, and other important tasks, ensuring they stay on schedule.
	Provide cost-effective administrative and secretarial support to the partners and other fee-earners to enable them to operate at optimum efficiency.
	Provide calendar management for Partners, including daily agendas and scheduling, ensuring accuracy and adherence to appropriate standards.
	Prepare, proofread, and format correspondences, memos and legal documents. Oversee the production of legal documents, coordinating with internal teams and external parties as necessary.
	Screen and prioritize emails, calls, and other communications on behalf of Partners Monitor deadlines and ensure the timely filing of legal documents, maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and court procedures.
	Track legal and billable activities and review invoices and payments to ensure timely processing. Coordinate logistics for legal meetings, conferences, and events, preparing materials, arranging catering, and coordinating travel as needed.


Qualifications, Skills & Experience


	HND/Bachelor’s degree in English, Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
	Minimum five (5) years of experience supporting senior level Executives in a corporate or legal environment.
	Proficiency in all Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
	Effective organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
	Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy in all activities especially with legal documents and correspondences.
	Exemplary professionalism and the ability to handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.
	Calendar and Schedule Management for Partners/Counsel
	Experience liaising with clients, counsel, Partners and external stakeholders professionally.
	Familiarity with Case Management/document management systems (e.g. document filing , court deadline tracking)

	Critical time management,

	High level of Confidentiality.

Client & Operation Support Officer Job at First Class Group Limited




        
    

        
        First Class Group Limited is a corporate services and utilityfirm specializingin cooling support services, HVAC systems, and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) infrastructure solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Client & Operation Support Officer

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsiblities
     

            
    




	Serve as a key point of contact for clients, vendors, creatives, and internal teams, ensuring enquiries, requests, and concerns are promptly addressed and followed up.
	Manage client communication and coordinate the resolution of project-related requests, ensuring a smooth and professional client experience.
	Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and other service providers to coordinate project requirements and deliverables.
	Support the coordination and execution of day-to-day creative projects, ensuring tasks, materials, and resources are available when required.
	Assist with the coordination of project schedules, meetings, deliveries, installations, and other operational activities.
	Support the management of company materials, equipment, creative tools, and supplies, including receiving, recording, organizing, and issuing items as required.
	Maintain accurate records of materials, equipment, project resources, client requests, vendor activities, and other operational documentation.
	Coordinate the movement and delivery of materials, artworks, equipment, and other items to project locations or clients.
	Follow up with internal teams and external partners to ensure projects and client requests are completed within agreed timelines.
	Provide general administrative and operational support to management and creative teams.
	Assist in maintaining effective communication and coordination across departments to ensure smooth project execution.
	Perform other duties and responsibilities as may reasonably be assigned by Management from time to time.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree with at least 2 years of work experience.


Salary
N180,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
